reason: I don't know a single person who's actually booked someone through this app, and I've been burned by a JustDial number before that went nowhere. A 'verified' badge on a screen doesn't mean much to me until someone from my street or my WhatsApp group tells me they used it and it actually worked out.
objection: If the plumber or electrician doesn't show up, or does bad work, who do I even call? With a neighbour's referral I know where to find the guy. With an app, verification is just a tick mark someone put on a form -- it doesn't tell me if he's good or if he'll turn up on time.
would_change_my_mind: If someone I actually know -- a relative, a neighbour, someone in my building's WhatsApp group -- used hithozha for a repair or event job and told me it went well, I'd try it once myself.
